messages:
diego: trying the hello-redwood sample app (Python). Followed README exactly, pip install redwood, set REDWOOD_API_KEY, ran examples/quickstart.py, got HTTPError: 402 Payment Required. Wtf?

rachael: do you have a workspace key or a personal key? 402 usually means the workspace trial expired or there's a billing hold.

diego: created a workspace for the team (org: signal-stack) and created the key from Workspace -> API keys. I expected samples to just work for early testing. No billing email popped up.

onboarding-bot: Welcome to Redwood! Note: workspace API keys may be restricted until a payment method is added. See https://app.redwood.ai/workspace/signal-stack/billing for details.

diego: hmm ok. The quickstart error output is just the Python requests exception and raw 402 body: {"error":"payment_required","message":"workspace billing_required"} — could be friendlier.

tyler: agreed. For quick unblocking you can either: 1) add a card to the workspace billing page, 2) create a personal API key at https://app.redwood.ai/account/api-keys, or 3) use the local emulator (rdw local) for offline dev.

diego: i don't want to add a card yet. Tried a personal key from my account, reran quickstart.py and it worked. first successful call! :)

rachael: nice. Filing two small DX items: (a) quickstart README should include a one-line note about workspace vs personal keys and link to billing, (b) SDK should map payment_required -> a single, human-friendly error type with a link and suggested actions.

diego: small weirdness: the sample app README has a curl example that uses Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_API_KEY but the Python sample uses redwood.Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY")) — could add a comment about env var precedence when using multiple accounts. I accidentally had a workspace key in my shell and a personal key in the IDE and it confused me.

tyler: good catch. Also we'll add a troubleshooting section: "If you were invited to a workspace, your workspace key may be gated by billing; use a personal key for first-run or add a payment method."

onboarding-bot: creating ticket: DX-4873 - quickstart: clarify workspace vs personal API keys in README and SDK error messages.

billing-bot: workspace signal-stack status: TRIAL_EXPIRED -> billing_required. Contact billing@redwood.ai to request trial reactivation.

diego: thanks all, resolved for me using a personal key. Leaving this thread here in case others hit it.

rachael: adding small doc PR now. tagging @product to decide if we want the SDK to include a direct billing link in error objects.

tyler: i'll handle the SDK change. plan: add error.code = "billing_required", error.help_url = "https://app.redwood.ai/workspace/<workspace>/billing" and surface it in the Python/Node clients.

diego: perfect. thanks :thumbsup:
